title: Sequential Beats Joint: On the Interplay between On-Policy Distillation and RLVR
abstract_first: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) and on-policy distillation (OPD) have emerged as two dominant methods for post-training reasoning LLMs.
